newsitem.title: CHINA: China computer prices expected to fall 25 pct.
newsitem.headline: China computer prices expected to fall 25 pct.

text.p: Prices for China-produced personal computers are expected to fall by about 25 percent during the remainder of the year due to improved technology and growing competition, the Business News said on Tuesday.
The major domestic computer makers have gained market share from foreign companies in the past year by cutting prices and are planning further price reductions, the newspaper said.
Personal computer sales in China totalled 1.8 million in 1996, a 56 percent jump over 1995, according to official media reports.
The Business News said sales were expected to hit three million in 1997.
